name: Kiler Holding Anonim Sirketi
summary: Kiler Holding Anonim Sirketi engages in the construction, energy, transportation, industry, and textile businesses in Turkey. The company plans, develops, and realizes the projects; and carries out infrastructure and superstructure contracting projects. It is also involved in the retail sale and wholesale of electrical energy directly to the consumers; provision of personnel transportation services to corporate customers; and open-end and ring-yarn production. In addition, the company packs and distributes sugar products, such as crystal granulated sugar, cube sugar, pulps, and molasses. Kiler Holding Anonim Sirketi was founded in 1983 and is based in Istanbul, Turkey.
